about: Sources of corpus v6 (data/build_corpus_v6.py). budget_tokens = unique tokens kept per source at the forge tokenizer (3.3 chars/token); yields are unknown until the filter stage has run and are reported by `status`. Entries with a `checked` note were looked up on the Hugging Face Hub on 2026-10-20; entries still marked verify:true have unchecked field names: run `inspect --source NAME` first and correct the entry if it fails. Tier A follows the licence policy of corpus v1-v5. Tier B (share-alike) is excluded by that policy (build_corpus.DENY lists CC-BY-SA). Tier C (web crawls with only a dataset licence) needs an owner decision. Never enable a source whose documents may contain outputs of closed models.

tiers.A: public domain, CC0, CC BY, permissive code licences (MIT, BSD, Apache, ISC, ...)
tiers.B: share-alike (CC BY-SA): excluded by the current policy
tiers.C: web crawl, dataset licence only (ODC-By): owner decision
